name: Galahad
summary: An EX-3 airframe re-fitted for long-duration crewed transfer between Earth orbit and lunar orbit. Ferries crew and modules; hands off to a dedicated lander at a lunar-orbit node. Not a lander.
description: EX-4 Galahad is the fleet’s crewed lunar vehicle: an EX-3 airframe re-fitted for long-duration crewed deep-space transfer between Earth orbit and lunar orbit. It is the culmination of the fleet. Galahad is NOT a lunar lander and no longer tries to be — combining Earth-orbit launch, cislunar transfer, and lunar landing in one vehicle was a punishing Δv stack; the ferry/lander split absorbs it.

specs.type: Crewed lunar ferry (EX-3 frame, deep-space re-fit)
specs.note: Deep-space dry drops ~4.85 t when wings are left at the node for the pure-vacuum legs.

capabilities.name: Crewed lunar ferry
capabilities.detail: Ferry crew and modules LEO → lunar orbit and back, exchanging with a dedicated lander (GX-04 Curiass) at a lunar-orbit node. Refuelled in orbit; fully-fuelled return capability.

calculations.title: Dry mass
calculations.method: EX-3 dry + lunar re-fit; subtract wings for pure-vacuum legs.
calculations.result: Full dry 31,373 kg; deep-space dry 26,525 kg (−4,848 kg wings left at node).

calculations.title: Cislunar closure
calculations.method: Δv via orbital refuelling + ferry/lander split.
calculations.note: The lander (Curiass) handles the surface legs.

blueprint.stations: Crew + deep-space systems replace the pure orbital payload fit.

sections.heading: Not a lander
sections.body: Galahad ferries crew and modules to lunar orbit and hands off to the dedicated GX-04 Curiass lander at a Luna-configuration MX-79 node. Neither vehicle does the other’s job — the punishing combined Δv of an all-in-one lunar vehicle is split across two purpose-built craft.

sections.heading: Culmination of the fleet
sections.body: EX-4 is where the architecture pays off: EX-3 feeds the depot, the depot fuels EX-4, EX-4 ferries to the lunar node, and the Curiass reaches the surface.

changelog.what: Lander role removed; became pure ferry
changelog.why: Earlier all-in-one (launch + transfer + landing) was a punishing Δv stack. Ferry/lander split closes it.

decisions.why: Splitting the Δv across two vehicles closes the budget and adds architectural redundancy.

openItems: Long-duration ECLSS + radiation shielding mass for multi-day transit.
